# hitl-approval-gate

> Human approval gate for agent actions with side effects: payload-bound requests, expiry, single use, no self-approval and a hash-chained audit log. Python package `trysac-hitl-approval-gate`, import name `hitl_approval_gate`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API

- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
